generalAbilities.name: Blood Scent
generalAbilities.description: A mandragora can smell creatures with blood as an imprecise sense at a range of 30 feet, and it can smell demons, fey, and sorcerers with blood as a precise sense at a range of 30 feet.

defensiveAbilities.name: Vulnerability to Supernatural Darkness
defensiveAbilities.description: Whenever a mandragora begins its turn in an area of magical darkness, it is Slowed 1 on that turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Apocalyptic Shriek
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The immense mandragora emits a devastating shriek. Each non-mandragora creature within 30 feet must attempt a DC 42 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Sickened 1 and takes 8d8 Mental Damage damage.

Failure The creature is Sickened 2 and takes 16d8 Mental Damage damage.

Critical Failure The creature is sickened 2, Slowed 1, and takes 150 Mental Damage damage. As long as the creature remains sickened, this slowed condition value can't be reduced below 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blood Drain
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The immense mandragora has a creature Grabbed

Effect The immense mandragora drains blood from the creature it has grabbed, dealing 12d6 Untyped Damage damage. If the creature is a demon, fey, or sorcerer, the mandragora gains temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. A creature that has its blood drained by a mandragora is Drained 2 until it receives healing of any kind or amount.

offensiveAbilities.name: Immense Mandragora Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 42 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 4d6 Poison Damage damage and Stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 Poison Damage damage, Confused, and stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 6d6 Poison Damage damage, confused, and stupefied 1 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Improved Grab as an action and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Improved Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
